liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Mama Tried** (2 reviews): Reviewer singles out its backbeat as the first thing that made them smile in the show; Reviewer says it ran longer than usual, with Garcia at his best [9][17]
- **Promised Land** (1 review): Reviewer found the opener a little underwhelming and sloppy, after a strong show the night before [9]
- **They Love Each Other** (1 review): Reviewer picks it as particularly nice [11]
- **Cassidy** (1 review): Reviewer calls it a perfect version within a strong first set [15]
- **Jack-A-Roe** (1 review): Reviewer says it was a welcome change of pace, but the band members were not in sync [9]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): Reviewer likes it; some in the crowd shouted requests for Alligator at its start [11]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Reviewer says Phil's vocal on it was unlike anything they had heard before [12]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-01-18.sbd.miller.fix-102444.103186.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 165 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer rates the soundboard about B+, with high levels [12]
- **gd79-01-18.rolfe.vernon.17175.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 167 min; rated 2.75/5 by 4 [4]. Said about its sound: Sounds at times like a soundboard; Weir is up in the mix, his fills clearly audible; Garcia's voice comes across well on this audience tape [13]
- **gd1979-01-18.nak300.rolfe.miller.100209.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 172 min; rated 4.57/5 by 7 [7]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls this the fullest and cleanest recording among the available versions; Reviewer says the recording sounds great [17][18]
- **gd1979-01-18.sbd.miller.102444.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 165 min [2]

## Around the show

- The show has no drums and no space segment, which the reviewer finds odd [18]
- Reviewer recalls snow and cold at the show, which they attended as a teenager [19]
- Garcia plays quite fast, as in most of the rest of the January run [13]
- Reviewer ranks it as middle of the road next to the other shows on this tour [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-01-18.sbd.miller.fix-102444.103186.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5) -> Cassette (Sony D5) [1]. Also: The soundboard source has a patch added to Jack-A-Roe; Tapes came from David Young and Rich Rothenberg; Joe B. Jones helped with pitch correction [1]
- **gd79-01-18.rolfe.vernon.17175.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Steve Rolfe; source: Audience Recording: TEAC PC-10 with nak 700 mic's fob [4]
- **gd1979-01-18.nak300.rolfe.miller.100209.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Steve Rolfe; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Nakamichi 300/CP1 -> Cassette Master (Maxell UDXLI/Dolby B) [7]. Also: Recorded with Sennheiser 441 microphones from front of board, to cassette master, then DAT, then CD; The Other One has two patched sections, supplied from the shnid 13058 source; Steve Rolfe lent his masters; Joe B. Jones helped pitch-correct the patch source [7]
- **gd1979-01-18.sbd.miller.102444.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5) -> Cassette (Sony D5) [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1979-01-18 Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1979-01-18-backstage-pass/) [22]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Providence Civic Center - January 18, 1979](https://www.dead.net/show/january-18-1979) [23]
- Poster by rirocks.net: [Grateful Dead 1979 01.18](http://rirocks.net/Band%20Articles/Grateful%20Dead%201979%2001.18%20-%20Prov.%20Civic%20Center.htm) [24]
